usage: nucleus_shell_contamination.py [-h] --seg SEG --bbox X0 Y0 Z0 X1 Y1 Z1
                                      [--nuclei NUCLEI] [--tol TOL]
                                      [--mip MIP] [--out OUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --seg SEG             precomputed segmentation cloudpath
  --bbox X0 Y0 Z0 X1 Y1 Z1
  --nuclei NUCLEI
  --tol TOL             share of a nucleus's mask below which a segment is
                        ignored
  --mip MIP
  --out OUT
